IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senate Committee on Health & Long-Term Care (originally sponsored by Senators Deccio, Thibaudeau, Winsley, Keiser, Franklin, Eide, Esser and Prentice)

Bill.BriefDescription: Allowing participation of denturists in preferred provider networks.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to participation of denturists in preferredprovider networks; and amending RCW 48.20.418, 48.21.148, 48.44.500,and 48.46.570.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 48.20.418 and 1995 c 1 s 21 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Notwithstanding any provision of any disability insurance contractcovering dental care as provided for in this chapter, effective January1, 1995, benefits shall not be denied thereunder for any serviceperformed by a denturist licensed under chapter 18.30 RCW if (1) theservice performed was within the lawful scope of such person's license,and (2) such contract would have provided benefits if such service hadbeen performed by a dentist licensed under chapter 18.32 RCW. Aninsurer shall allow a denturist to participate in any preferredprovider network to the same extent, and under the same terms andconditions, as a dentist.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 48.21.148 and 1995 c 1 s 22 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Notwithstanding any provision of any group disability insurancecontract or blanket disability insurance contract covering dental careas provided for in this chapter, effective January 1, 1995, benefitsshall not be denied thereunder for any service performed by a denturistlicensed under chapter 18.30 RCW if (1) the service performed waswithin the lawful scope of such person's license, and (2) such contractwould have provided benefits if such service had been performed by adentist licensed under chapter 18.32 RCW. An insurer shall allow adenturist to participate in any preferred provider network to the sameextent, and under the same terms and conditions, as a dentist.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 48.44.500 and 1995 c 1 s 24 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notwithstanding any provision of any health care servicecontract covering dental care as provided for in this chapter,effective January 1, 1995, benefits shall not be denied thereunder forany service performed by a denturist licensed under chapter 18.30 RCWif (((1))) (a) the service performed was within the lawful scope ofsuch person's license, and (((2))) (b) such contract would haveprovided benefits if such service had been performed by a dentistlicensed under chapter 18.32 RCW. (2) Except as provided in subsection (3) of this section, a healthcare service contractor shall allow a denturist to participate in anypreferred provider network to the same extent, and under the same termsand conditions, as a dentist. (3) Subsection (2) of this section does not apply to a health careservice contractor that employs one or more denturists and contractswith a group dental practice on a reciprocal exclusive basis.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 48.46.570 and 1995 c 1 s 25 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Notwithstanding any provision of any health maintenanceorganization agreement covering dental care as provided for in thischapter, effective January 1, 1995, benefits shall not be deniedthereunder for any service performed by a denturist licensed underchapter 18.30 RCW if (((1))) (a) the service performed was within thelawful scope of such person's license, and (((2))) (b) such agreement SSB 6319 p. 2 would have provided benefits if such service had been performed by adentist licensed under chapter 18.32 RCW. (2) Except as provided in subsection (3) of this section, a healthmaintenance organization shall allow a denturist to participate in anypreferred provider network to the same extent, and under the same termsand conditions, as a dentist. (3) Subsection (2) of this section does not apply to a healthmaintenance organization that employs one or more denturists andcontracts with a group dental practice on a reciprocal exclusive basis.
